FIXED. New lane: `skillChoices[].optionsFromChoiceFlag` — a slot the printed sentence DERIVES from an answer the character already gave, rather than asking again. 'You become trained in Survival and the skill associated with the magical tradition from your magiphage ability (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, or Religion for divine).' The tradition is asked ONCE, on the ancestry (ancestries.surki.choice.flag = magiphageTradition), and their row derives the skill from that same answer through four SURKI_TRADITION conditionals. Ours shipped four live options, so a primal surki could train Arcana off a feat whose own parenthesis names Nature — and because an unanswered slot resolves to options[0], a surki who touched nothing was silently trained in ARCANA whatever their tradition. Not a menu-filtering call: leaving four options live is not filtering, it is asking a question neither authority asks. Built as ONE narrowing shared by the engine and the builder's picker (skillSlotOptions), because narrowing in one of them only is what makes a sheet and a builder disagree; the flag lookup was extracted out of narrowSpellFilter into choiceFlagAnswer so there is a single search for 'where was this flag answered' (it already had the ancestry branch, added for this very answer). `content` is now a REQUIRED parameter of featSkillChoiceValue and boundGrantChoice rather than optional, so a caller cannot silently skip the narrowing. Authored in HAND_AUTHORED_GRANTS, not featGrantsAuto.ts, which is re-serialised whole by scripts that cannot emit the new field; the redundancy clause (which their row does not implement at all) is restated so the merge does not drop it.
